raw_text: Chinese naval vessels at Hambantota Port again — Type 054A frigate among them. This is the second PLAN port call to Hambantota in 2024. The 99-year lease arrangement gives China persistent access to this deep-water port. India's concerns about the String of Pearls are well founded at this point. Watch for Indian Navy countermoves in the southern IOR.
